text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain's cabinet praises performance of Bahrain Stock Exchange. Shares worth 66.6 million dinars were traded in the bourse in 1996.
- Bahrain hosts telecommunication exhibition this month.
- World Health Organisation completes report on the control and usage of imported chemicals in Bahrain.
- Labour minister signs memorandum of understanding with Greek agricultural development institute to exchange information.
